events.verdict: Murray (SAC) is drawn towards Christie's (DAL) space on the pump fake and makes contact with Christie's left arm and shoulder as he steps towards the basket during his upward shooting motion.
Irving (DAL) lowers his right arm down towards the ball and avoids making illegal contact with Monk (SAC) while contesting his driving shot attempt in the paint.
Dinwiddie (DAL) extends his off-arm into Monk (SAC), dislodging him from his defensive position.
Sabonis (SAC) is in the paint for longer than three seconds.

Thompson (DAL) obtains a legal guarding position in front of DeRozan (SAC) prior to the start of his jump shooting motion. DeRozan drifts forwards into Thompson, who continues to remain in his legal guarding position.
Sabonis (SAC) engages with Irving (DAL) near the basket and releases away to grab the rebound.
Murray (SAC) briefly grasps Prosper's (DAL) jersey as he pursues the rebound.
Dinwiddie (DAL) legally contests Murray's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Christie (DAL) makes incidental contact with Sabonis's (SAC) arm after he tips the ball.
Dinwiddie (DAL) and Monk (SAC) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Prosper (DAL) establishes himself in a wide screening position and the illegal foot contact that occurs causes LaVine (SAC) to lose his balance as he moves around the screen.
Sabonis (SAC) legally contests Prosper's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up over his left leg and marginal contact occurs as Irving (DAL) moves into the pick.
DeRozan (SAC) extends his left arm out and avoids making any illegal contact with Irving (DAL) while contesting Irving's driving shot attempt.
Monk (SAC) legally contests Irving's (DAL) driving shot attempt at the basket.

Marshall (DAL) briefly has his arms wrapped around DeRozan (SAC), who is allowed to move freely. DeRozan makes incidental foot contact with his teammate LaVine (SAC), causing him to trip to the floor.
Edwards (DAL) moves forwards into Monk (SAC), initiating illegal body contact before he makes contact to the ball.
Christie (DAL) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) brushes Irving's (DAL) side as he elevates for the shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Monk (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Irving's (DAL) drive to the basket and makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it.
Monk (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Irving (DAL) firms up in Sabonis's (SAC) path and Irving loses his balance on his own accord and goes to the ground.
Ellis (SAC) makes direct contact with the ball and legally blocks Edwards' (DAL) shot attempt in the paint.
Edwards (DAL) legally blocks Monk's (SAC) floater attempt in the paint.
Monk's (SAC) shot attempt is blocked by Edwards (DAL) and he legally recovers the loose ball in the air and immediately releases a shot attempt.
Marshall (DAL) brushes Monk's (SAC) left arm as he takes it off the ball during his layup attempt.
Christie (DAL) illegally extends his arms into Ellis's (SAC) path as he attempts to defend over the pick.
Edwards (DAL) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Dinwiddie (DAL) engages with Sabonis (SAC) during the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Sabonis (SAC) contests Marshall's (DAL) shot attempt and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Irving (DAL) swipes his right hand down and makes contact with Sabonis's (SAC) arm, which impacts his shot attempt in the paint,
Edwards (DAL) legally contests Monk's (SAC) driving shot attempt in the paint.
Dinwiddie (DAL) firms up over his left leg in Ellis's (SAC) path and Ellis accentuates the contact when he briefly hooks Dinwiddie's leg. The contact between the two players quickly dissolves.
LaVine (SAC) legally contests Irving's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
DeRozan (SAC) places his off-arm against Marshall (DAL) before releasing away as he steps back.
Marshall (DAL) makes illegal contact to DeRozan's (SAC) forearm during his jump shot attempt.
Edwards' (DAL) arms are briefly extended as he braces for the ensuing contact with Ellis (SAC) as he establishes himself in his path.
LaRavia (SAC) legally contests Irving's (DAL) driving shot attempt at the basket.
DeRozan's (SAC) shot attempt enters the cylinder from below, which is considered out of bounds.
Murray (SAC) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

Dinwiddie (DAL) initiates the marginal contact with DeRozan (SAC) by extending his leg into his path. The contact does not affect DeRozan's SQBR and DeRozan does not dislodge Dinwiddie from his defensive position by initiating any contact.

Monk (SAC) firms up in a legal guarding position and is dislodged from his defensive position when Dinwiddie (DAL) extends his arms. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is confirmed that the offensive foul call occurs prior to the expiration of the game clock.
